title: 第1308章 感念韩公第1307章 一甲子后检测修为
content_zh:
分发完神子，陈平不再拖沓，亲自出手，为所有抵达瓶颈，满足条件的弟子，开启金丹突破机缘。
如今他掌控的资源，能够轻松让弟子，手下突破金丹！
在他的助力之下，门下弟子突破金丹，成功率可达到十成。
接下来的三个月时间，青山洞天上空，雷劫此起彼伏，轰鸣不绝。
一道道金丹雷劫降落，洗礼弟子肉身，淬炼灵力根基。
从这一日开始，青山势力全员进阶，彻底全面踏入金丹时代，中坚战力实现质的飞跃。
稳固好青山所有事务，确认全员修行步入正轨之后，陈平不再停留，即刻动身，全速折返青云宗。
化神丹主药的机缘线索现世，极为珍稀，时效性极强，他不敢浪费分毫时间，必须尽快筹备，外出探寻。
刚刚返回青云宗山门，值守弟子认出陈平身份，不敢耽搁，立刻快步前往后山闭关洞府，通报掌门李灵风。
不多时，李灵风满面红光，快步出关，神色昂扬，气息浑厚。
陈平一眼便能看出，李灵风闭关多年，顺利突破境界，如今修为稳固金丹四层。
双灵根资质，能够在数十年时间，从金丹一层突破至金丹四层，进度极快，心性、根基、机缘，皆是上等。
紧随其后，赵元启也快速赶来会面。
他气息凝练，灵力厚重，周身道韵浓郁，修为已然抵达金丹圆满。
距离突破元婴境界，只差最后一步沉淀，随时可以破关进阶。
陈平看着赵元启的修行进度，依旧心生诧异。
三人齐聚大殿，简单寒暄叙旧，聊完宗门琐事、弟子近况、疆域发展之后，迅速切入正题。
赵元启神色收敛笑意，神情郑重，开口说道。
"师兄，你打探的化神丹主药，确实有确切下落，线索真实无误。"
"但此番机缘，暗藏古怪，绝非寻常天材地宝出世那么简单。"

陈平抬眼询问。
"何处古怪？莫非有高阶禁制、强者镇守，无法蛮力破解？"
赵元启微微摇头，语气严肃。
"并非禁制强悍，也不是镇守者难缠。此番机缘布局，套路和早年韩道人如出一辙。"
"以真实的顶级机缘作为诱饵，布设陷阱，故意泄露线索，引诱你主动入局，暗藏凶险。"
听完这番话，陈平脸上没有丝毫忌惮，眼底反而浮出喜色。
他心中清楚，韩道人看似布设陷阱、算计他人，实则是专属自己的送宝童子。
每一次布局算计，最终都会被自己破局，白白送出顶级机缘。
时隔多年，对方终于再次布局，摆明了要给自己送新一轮的机缘至宝。
陈平语气笃定，沉声开口。
"师兄无需多言，不管是陷阱还是机缘，此番我必须去。"
……
东州极北之地，和北州界域搭界的地方，有一片海域。
content_en:
After distributing the Sons of God, Chen Ping stopped procrastinating and took action himself, opening up the opportunity for a Golden Elixir breakthrough for all disciples who reached the bottleneck and met the conditions.
Now that he has the resources under his control, he can easily allow his disciples and subordinates to break through the golden elixir!
With his help, his disciples can break through the golden elixir with a success rate of 100%.
In the next three months, thunder tribulations occurred one after another in the sky above Qingshan Cave, and they roared incessantly.
One after another golden elixir thunder calamity descended, baptizing the disciple's physical body and tempering the foundation of spiritual power.
From this day on, all members of the Qingshan force advanced, completely entering the Golden Elixir era, and achieving a qualitative leap in their backbone combat strength.
After stabilizing all affairs in Qingshan and confirming that the cultivation of all members was on the right track, Chen Ping set off immediately and returned to Qingyun Sect at full speed.
A chance clue to the main medicine of the Transformation Pill appeared in the world. It was extremely rare and highly time-sensitive. He did not dare to waste any time. He had to prepare as soon as possible and go out to explore.
Just after returning to the Qingyun Sect's mountain gate, the disciple on duty recognized Chen Ping's identity and did not dare to delay. He immediately went to the retreat cave in the back mountain and informed the leader Li Lingfeng.
Not long after, Li Lingfeng's face glowed brightly and he quickly walked out of the seclusion, his expression high-spirited and his breath strong.
Chen Ping could tell at a glance that Li Lingfeng had been in seclusion for many years, successfully broke through the realm, and was now at the fourth level of Jindan.
The dual spiritual root qualification can break through from the first level of the golden elixir to the fourth level of the golden elixir in a matter of decades. The progress is extremely fast. The character, foundation, and opportunities are all top-notch.
Immediately afterwards, Zhao Yuanqi also quickly came to meet.
His aura is condensed, his spiritual power is thick, his whole body is rich in Tao charm, and his cultivation has reached the perfection of the golden elixir.
There is only one final step left to break through to the Nascent Soul realm, and you can break through and advance at any time.
Chen Ping looked at Zhao Yuanqi's practice progress and was still surprised.
The three of them gathered in the main hall and exchanged simple greetings to reminisce about the past. After chatting about the trivial matters of the sect, the current situation of the disciples, and the development of the territory, they quickly got to the point.
Zhao Yuanqi suppressed his smile and spoke solemnly.
"Senior Brother, the main ingredient of the God Transformation Pill you are searching for does have the exact whereabouts, and the clues are true and correct."
"But this opportunity has hidden weirdness. It is by no means as simple as the birth of an ordinary treasure."
Chen Ping raised his eyes and asked.
"What's weird? Could it be that there are high-level restrictions, guarded by strong men, that cannot be broken through with brute force?"
Zhao Yuanqi shook his head slightly with a serious tone.
"It's not that the restrictions are strong, nor that the defenders are difficult to deal with. The timing of this arrangement is exactly the same as that of Taoist Han in the early years."
"Use real top opportunities as bait, set up traps, and deliberately leak clues to lure you into the game, hiding dangers."
After hearing these words, Chen Ping didn't have any fear on his face, but his eyes were filled with joy.
He knew in his heart that Taoist Han seemed to be setting traps and plotting against others, but in fact he was his own treasure-delivery boy.
Every time he makes a plan, he will eventually be defeated by himself, giving away top opportunities in vain.
After many years, the other party finally made plans again and made it clear that he would give himself a new round of chance treasures.
Chen Ping spoke with a firm tone and a deep voice.
"Senior brother, there is no need to say anything. Whether it is a trap or an opportunity, I must go this time."
…
In the far north of Dongzhou, where it borders Beizhou, there is a sea area.
